head: Digimon Alysion release: Bandai's free card game is out on iPhone
dek: Bandai released Digimon Alysion on 25 November, a free Digimon card game for iPhone and iPad with its own story, a beginner tutorial, a free card pack each day and ranked online battles; it was #12 among free games on the US App Store that day.
details: You build decks, spar with friends and story characters, and raise and digivolve Digimon up to Mega to fill a Digidex of more than 100 entries. In-app purchases of DigiGems run from $0.99 to $64.99, and the listing says the game has loot boxes (random-item purchases). It's rated 9+, needs iOS 17.6 or later and is about 170 MB.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 17.6 or later), free with in-app purchases
means: If you like Digimon or card games, you can start for free with a daily pack, but the game sells random card packs for real money.
todo: Download it from the App Store; parents can turn off in-app purchases in Screen Time.
thumb_words: DIGIMON CARD GAME OUT ON IPHONE
